name: Restaurant Menu
view:
<ListView theme="dark" limit={items.length + 2}>
  <ListViewItem key="header" gap={0}>
    <Box flex={1} direction="row" align="center" gap={3} padding={3} radius="xl" background="surface-elevated-secondary">
      <Box size={44} radius="lg" background="alpha-15" align="center" justify="center">
        <Title value="🍽️" size="md" />
      </Box>
      <Col flex={1} gap={0}>
        <Title value={labels.title} size="sm" />
        <Caption value={labels.subtitle} />
      </Col>
      <Row gap={1}>
        <Button
          label="EN"
          size="sm"
          variant={lang === "en" ? "solid" : "outline"}
          onClickAction={{ type: "locale.set", payload: { lang: "en" }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "container" }}
        />
        <Button
          label="عربي"
          size="sm"
          variant={lang === "ar" ? "solid" : "outline"}
          onClickAction={{ type: "locale.set", payload: { lang: "ar" }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "container" }}
        />
      </Row>
    </Box>
  </ListViewItem>
  {items.map((item, i) => (
    <ListViewItem key={item.id} gap={3}>
      <Box size={48} radius="lg" background="alpha-10" align="center" justify="center">
        <Title value={item.emoji} size="lg" />
      </Box>
      <Col flex={1} gap={0}>
        <Text value={item.name} size="sm" weight="semibold" color={item.available ? "prose" : "tertiary"} />
        <Row gap={2}>
          <Caption value={item.price} />
          {!item.available && <Badge label={labels.sold_out} color="danger" size="sm" />}
        </Row>
      </Col>
      <Row gap={1}>
        <Button
          label="−"
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          uniform
          disabled={item.qty === 0}
          onClickAction={{ type: "cart.remove", payload: { id: item.id, position: i + 1 }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "self" }}
        />
        <Box minWidth={24} align="center">
          <Text value={`${item.qty}`} size="sm" weight="semibold" />
        </Box>
        <Button
          label="+"
          size="sm"
          style="primary"
          uniform
          disabled={!item.available}
          onClickAction={{ type: "cart.add", payload: { id: item.id, position: i + 1 }, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "self" }}
        />
      </Row>
    </ListViewItem>
  ))}
  <ListViewItem key="footer" gap={0}>
    <Box flex={1} gap={3} padding={3} radius="xl" background="surface-elevated-secondary" border={{ size: 1, color: "subtle" }}>
      <Row>
        <Text value={labels.your_order} weight="semibold" />
        <Spacer />
        <Caption value={cart.item_count} />
      </Row>
      <Col gap={1}>
        <Row>
          <Caption value={cart.delivery_label} />
          <Spacer />
          <Caption value={cart.delivery_progress} />
        </Row>
        <Box height={6} radius="full" background="alpha-15">
          <Box width={cart.delivery_percent} height="100%" radius="full" background="orange-400" />
        </Box>
      </Col>
      <Row>
        <Text value={labels.subtotal} size="sm" color="secondary" />
        <Spacer />
        <Title value={cart.subtotal} size="sm" />
      </Row>
      {cart.blocked && (
        <Row gap={2}>
          <Icon name="info" size="sm" color="warning" />
          <Text value={labels.blocked} size="sm" color="warning" />
        </Row>
      )}
      <Button
        label={labels.checkout}
        style="primary"
        block
        disabled={cart.blocked}
        onClickAction={{ type: "checkout.start", payload: {}, handler: "server", loadingBehavior: "container" }}
      />
    </Box>
  </ListViewItem>
</ListView>

schema:
import { z } from "zod"

const Item = z.strictObject({
  id: z.string().min(1),
  emoji: z.string(),
  name: z.string().min(1),
  price: z.string(),
  qty: z.number().int().min(0).max(99),
  available: z.boolean(),
})

const WidgetState = z.strictObject({
  lang: z.enum(["en", "ar"]),
  labels: z.strictObject({
    title: z.string(),
    subtitle: z.string(),
    sold_out: z.string(),
    your_order: z.string(),
    subtotal: z.string(),
    blocked: z.string(),
    checkout: z.string(),
  }),
  items: z.array(Item).min(1),
  cart: z.strictObject({
    item_count: z.string(),
    delivery_label: z.string(),
    delivery_progress: z.string(),
    delivery_percent: z.string(),
    subtotal: z.string(),
    blocked: z.boolean(),
  }),
})

export default WidgetState
